expected_level_description: You can: - plan and lead complex tenders, choosing the right route to market and procedure - help users write outcome-based specifications for digital and clinical systems - manage timetables, risks, and stakeholders through to contract award
You can: - check bids for compliance and completeness - support evaluators and record scores and moderation notes - prepare price evaluation models under guidance
You can: - apply the procurement rules that fit a straightforward purchase - publish notices and keep records that meet transparency rules - spot when a request risks breaking the rules and raise it

You can: - buy standard software, hardware, and licences through frameworks - track licence numbers, renewals, and true-up dates - include standard security and data protection requirements in documents
You can: - gather market information, prices, and supplier details for a requirement - run a request for information and summarise the responses
You can: - negotiate prices and terms for low-value or routine purchases - prepare data and options for a negotiation led by others
You can: - include standard social value and sustainability questions in tenders - collect social value reports from suppliers

You can: - estimate the value of each item on your roadmap - compare effort to value when deciding priorities - decide when it's appropriate to reuse something, and when it's not - decide how and when to escalate risk in achieving value - discuss estimates with stakeholders to validate understanding - analyse the benefit of investment against anticipated outcomes

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
